name: 伊兰亚龙
evolution: 伊雷龙 → 伊兰亚龙 Lv.40 → 伊兰龙
description: 修长的尾鳍在空气中划过会留下水雾的痕迹，水雾持续存在形成云朵。观测显示，伊兰亚龙停留超过半小时的区域，降雨概率提升67%。干旱季节时，它们会主动迁往缺水的农田上空。
descriptionEn: The slender tail fin leaves trails of water mist in the air, and the mist persists to form clouds. Observations show that in areas where Yilanyalong stays for over half an hour, the probability of rainfall increases by 67%. During drought seasons, they actively migrate to the skies above water-scarce farmland.

skills.name: 绵里藏针
skills.description: 造成魔伤，若自己上回合未使用攻击技能，本技能威力永久+20。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; if no attack skill was used last turn, this skill's power permanently +20.

skills.name: 角击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, in response to attacks.

skills.name: 架势
skills.description: 自己回复20%生命，下次技能无需蓄力。
skills.descriptionEn: Recovers 20% HP; next skill requires no charge-up.

skills.name: 升龙咆哮
skills.description: 蓄力，对敌方造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Charge-up; deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 龙吟
skills.description: 蓄力，自己获得双攻+150%和速度+80。
skills.descriptionEn: Charge-up; gains both ATK +150% and Speed +80.

skills.name: 湮灭
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 龙威
skills.descriptionEn: Gains 1 layer of Dragon Devour Mark.

skills.name: 怨力打击
skills.description: 蓄力，造成魔伤，若蓄力期间受到攻击，本技能威力变为敌方技能威力的3倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Charge-up; deals magic damage; if attacked during charge-up, this skill's power becomes 3x the enemy's skill power.

skills.name: 应激反应
skills.description: 自己回复25%生命，应对防御：改为回复50%生命。
skills.descriptionEn: Recovers 25% HP; against Defense: recovers 50% HP instead.

skills.name: 龙息环爆
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：下次技能无需蓄力。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; against status: next skill requires no charge-up.

skills.name: 突袭
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为3倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; against status: this skill's power becomes 3x.
